messages:
Jordan: Quick sync: we need a small migration page for callable outputs (v1 -> v2) + one canonical page with tiny examples for Python/TS/Go. Also tidy links in examples/legacy.
Priya: I can draft the migration prose. Keep it consumable: 3 bullet steps, code snippets, and a note about tokenization differences.
Max: I'll curate examples. My plan: single page at /docs/callable-output/overview.md with sections: summary, schemas, SDK examples, fallback patterns, testing.
Nora: I'll run compatibility tests on the runtime side and add a blurb about model-variant fallbacks (e.g., when structured output missing).
Jordan: Important: include a compact JSON schema example that demonstrates nullable arrays + union types. Example we can inline:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "action": { "type": "string" },
    "items": {
      "oneOf": [
        { "type": "null" },
        { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": ["action"]
}
```
Priya: Migration note outline: 1) validate responses against schema, 2) use compat shim for older SDKs, 3) add heuristic fallback when parsing fails. Keep code under 6 lines each.
Max: I'll add a Go example since some customers asked. Minimal snippet:
```go
resp, _ := client.CallTool(ctx, "tasker", map[string]interface{}{"q":"status"})
if resp.IsStructured() {
  var out map[string]interface{}
  resp.ParseJSON(&out)
} else {
  out := heuristicParse(resp.Text)
}
```
Nora: For guardrails I suggest three tiny testcases: missing required key -> expect validation error, extra unknown key -> log warning, items=null -> accepted if schema allows. I'll wire these into docs CI so they run on PRs.
docs-bot: Link scanner: scanned examples/legacy, found 12 outdated anchors. Recommend redirecting to /docs/callable-output/overview.md.
Jordan: Action items: Priya write migration copy; Max author canonical page + examples; Nora add tests + runtime note; Jordan to sweep links and add redirects from legacy pages.
Priya: Drafting migration text now. Will include the compat import snippet: `from rwd.compat import parse_structured` and a short paragraph about tokenization causing truncated JSON in some models.
Max: I'll consolidate all snippets into one file and expose sub-anchors. Also will add a tiny parse-fallback JS function that prefers schema.validate then JSON.parse then regex fallback.
Nora: Started runtime checks: on older models we've seen isolated cases of trailing commas. I'll add a short note recommending trimming and a small regex cleanup before parse.
Jordan: Let's keep the canonical snippets under 30 lines each. No duplication. If you need to keep legacy copies, add `x-archive` anchor and a redirect page.
Max: Opening draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4905 (WIP) — contains Python + TS + Go examples and schema section.
Priya: Migration PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4906 — prose + short examples.
Nora: I'll add tests to https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4907 and attach CI badges.
devex-bot: Reminder: tag `devex` for SDK snippet review and `eng-runtime` for fallback guidance.
Jordan: Tagging reviewers: @Priya @Max @Nora @devex. Please ping when PRs are ready for review.
Max: Will run link-checker after link redirects are added.
Priya: Migration blurb added; requesting review from @Emily (docowner).
Jordan: Let's aim to merge by next Wednesday. If blockers appear, escalate to `docs-sprint` channel.
Max: All good from my side, keeping snippets minimal and tested.
Nora: Runtime tests green for the guardrail cases :white_check_mark:. Added note about logging parse failures to observability.
Jordan: Thanks team — I'll post the final merged PR links here once merged and close the legacy redirect issues.
docs-bot: CI: link-check passed on branch 4905 except for two anchors that were fixed in 4906.
Priya: Emily approved the migration wording.
Jordan: Merged main PRs and added redirects. Closing thread after a post-merge verification run.
Max: Post-merge verification green. Leaving a small follow-up issue for i18n of the migration page.
Jordan: Thread closed. Post any follow-ups in #docs or reopen.
